name: @stapel/cdn-react
description: Headless React pair for stapel-cdn: a typed media-upload client whose flow is dedup-first — SHA-256 the bytes, ask file/exists/, and skip the POST entirely when the CDN already holds them. A phase-shaped upload bag (validate → hash → check → upload → variants), an ordered queue with per-item cancel/retry/remove and a max, object-URL previews with the revoke built in (@stapel/core's useObjectUrlPreview), and the opaque `<type>/<hash>` reference every consuming module actually stores. Client-side limits mirror the backend's own declared ceilings and never refuse what the server would accept. Zero visual opinion in the main entry; an opt-in /default subpath ships the antd skin.

size-limit.name: index — headless pair (client + dedup-first upload flow + queue + the batching describe loader), no antd Raised 9.5 -> 11.6 KB in 0.5.0: the microphone and the general one-file upload. Three modules land in the HEADLESS entry and all three are rule rather than surface — `useMediaUpload` (one pick in, the opaque `<type>/<hash>` key and the render snapshot the upload response already carried out, so a caller never spends a describe round trip on a reference it just made), `model/recording.ts` (the container preference order asked against the engine's own isTypeSupported, the DOMException-name classifier and the RMS meter arithmetic) and `useMediaRecorder` (the capture, whose bytes arrive AFTER stop() returns and whose every exit has to stop the stream's tracks). Measured on this dist with dependencies held constant, this package's src at HEAD and then with the change: 8.75 -> 11.16 KB, 2.41 KB. A 440 B ceiling over the measured figure is a gate that measures this package rather than whoever built core last. Raised 11.6 -> 11.9 KB in 0.6.0: the audio intake — a fourth arm on CdnUploadTarget/targetAssetType/targetFileKind/uploadTo/limitsForTarget, the audio ceilings in CDN_DEFAULT_LIMITS, uploadAudio on the client, and useVoiceUpload (the clip named from its own container, the length stated honestly as measured-or-clocked). Measured on this dist with dependencies held constant, this package's src at HEAD and then with the change: 11.16 -> 11.58 KB, 420 B, which left 20 B under the old ceiling — a gate that fails on the next honest byte. A 320 B ceiling over the measured figure.

default — the antd upload + attachment skin must stay out of the main bundle Raised 13 -> 15.3 KB in 0.5.0: <VoiceRecordButton/>, the fifth surface. It is a control with five things it can be doing and six ways of being unable to, and the bytes are mostly the arms rather than the button: the recording row (a clock, the level meter drawn as a token-styled track, a discard control), the visually-hidden status line that says the elapsed time as a sentence for a reader that gets no layout, and four mutually exclusive notices below it (the gesture hint, the refusal, the take that produced nothing, the take that ended at the ceiling) which are four and not one because they answer four different questions. Measured on this dist with dependencies held constant, this package's src at HEAD and then with the change: 12.30 -> 14.87 KB, 2.57 KB. Raised 15.3 -> 16.3 KB in 0.6.0: <VoiceRecordButton onUploaded> — the record-and-upload arm. Two components under one switch rather than one with a conditional hook (the record-only arm needs no CdnProvider and keeps not needing one), the control disabled while the previous take is still being stored (a second take would abort the first upload), the step named under it, and the pair's own inline error surface for a refused upload. Measured on this dist with dependencies held constant, this package's src at HEAD and then with the change: 14.87 -> 15.94 KB, 1.07 KB. A 360 B ceiling over the measured figure.

i18n/ru — the Russian bundle is opt-in, not carried by the main entry Raised 3 -> 3.4 KB in 0.5.0: the microphone's seventeen keys — five controls and states, the elapsed and limit sentences, the meter's accessible name, the take that recorded nothing, and the SIX refusals, which are six because "open the https page", "use another browser", "allow the microphone" and "plug one in" are four different next actions and one grey button that says none of them is how a person concludes the feature is broken. Measured with dependencies held constant, this package's src at HEAD and then with the change: 2.66 -> 3.07 KB, 410 B.

i18n/es — the Spanish bundle is opt-in, not carried by the main entry 0.5.0 adds the same seventeen microphone keys and the ceiling does NOT move: measured with dependencies held constant, 2.02 -> 2.35 KB, which still leaves 150 B under the standing 2.5 KB. Raising a ceiling the measurement did not reach would be a margin rather than a gate.
